30:18: 18 - And to Him be praise in the heavens and the earth, and in the evening and when you reach the zenith. Praise is given specifically to the evening, which is the end of the day, from the twilight of the eye when its light decreases, and to noon, which is its middle, because blessings are renewed more in them. It is possible that in the evening is connected to when you reach the evening. His statement, And to Him be praise in the heavens and the earth is an objection. It was narrated from Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with him, that the verse includes the five daily prayers. When you reach the evening is the Maghrib and Isha prayers, When you reach the morning is the Fajr prayer, In the evening is the Asr prayer, and When you reach the zenith is the Dhuhr prayer. That is why Al-Hasan claimed that it was Madinan, because he used to say that two rak'ahs were obligatory in Makkah at any time they coincided, but the five were only made obligatory in Madinah, and most of them were made obligatory in Makkah. It was narrated from him, peace and blessings be upon him, Whoever would like to be measured with the fullest measure, let him say, 'Glory be to God when you reach the evening' the verse. And on the authority of him, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, “Whoever says in the morning, ‘Glory be to God, when you go to bed,’ until his saying, ‘And thus you go out,’ will make up for what he missed during the night. And whoever says it in the evening will make up for what he missed during the day.” And it was recited, When you go to bed and When you go to bed, meaning you spend the evening there and you spend the morning there.
30:19: 19 - He brings forth the living from the dead like a human being from a sperm-drop and a bird from an egg. And He brings forth the dead from the living like a sperm-drop and an egg, or life is followed by death and vice versa. And He revives the earth with vegetation. After its death He dries it up. And likewise and similar to that bringing forth. You come forth from your graves, for it is also the following of life by death. Hamzah and Al-Kisa'i read it with a fat-ha on the ta'.
30:20: 20 - And among His signs is that He created you from dust meaning in the origin of creation because He created their origin from it. Then suddenly you were human beings spreading out then you were suddenly surprised at the time when you were human beings spreading out across the earth.
30:21: 21 - And among His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves because Eve was created from Adam's rib and all other women were created from the sperm of men, or because they are of their kind and not another kind. That you may find tranquility in them so that you may be drawn to them and be at peace with them, because kindred spirits are a cause for inclusion and difference is a cause of discord. And He placed between you that is, between men and women, or between members of the species, affection and mercy by means of marriage during arousal and other things, unlike other animals, to regulate the matter of livelihood, or so that human life depends on knowing one another and cooperating, which requires affection and compassion. It was said that affection is a metaphor for sexual intercourse and mercy for children, as God Almighty said: and a mercy from Us. "Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought" so that they know the wisdom in it.
30:22: 22 - And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages your languages by teaching each species its language or inspiring it to create it and enabling it to do so, or the kinds of your sperm and its shapes, for you will hardly ever hear two speeches that are equal in quality. And your colors the whiteness and blackness of the skin, or the outlines of the limbs and their shapes and colors, and their adornments such that distinction and recognition have occurred, so that twins, despite the agreement of their materials and causes and the matters that meet them in creation, will inevitably differ in some of that. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge that are hardly hidden from any rational being, whether angel, human, or jinn. Hafs read it with a kasra on the lam, and this supports his statement: And none grasps it except those of knowledge.
30:23: 23 - And among His signs is your sleep by night and by day and your seeking of His bounty. Your sleep in both times is for the rest of the psychological powers and the strengthening of the natural powers and for seeking your livelihood in them, or your sleep by night and your seeking it by day. He separated and joined the two times and the two actions with two conjunctions to indicate that each of the two times, if it is specific to one of them, is suitable for the other when needed, and this is supported by all the other verses that came about it. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen. Hearing with understanding and insight, for the wisdom in it is clear.
30:24: 24 - And among His signs is that He shows you lightning. It is understood that the source is an, as in His saying: Oh you who deter! Come to the battle and witness the pleasures! Will you make me immortal? Or the verb has the status of a verbal noun, as in their saying: Hearing about Al-Mu’idi is better than seeing him, or it is an attribute of something omitted, the meaning of which is a sign with which he shows you lightning, as in his saying: Life is nothing but two tarts, one of which I die, and the other I struggle to live. For fear of lightning for the traveler. And in hope of rain for the resident. They are in the accusative case as a reason for an action that is necessary for the mentioned, since seeing them necessitates seeing them or him, based on the estimation of an added word, such as wanting fear and hope, or interpreting fear and hope as frightening and hoping, like your saying, I did it in spite of Satan, or as a state, such as speaking to him verbally. And He sends down water from the sky, and it is read with emphasis. And He revives the earth thereby with vegetation. After its death, it dries it up. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason, who use their minds to deduce its causes and how it comes into being, so that the perfection of the Creator's power and wisdom may be revealed to them.
30:25: 25 - And among His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand by His command Their standing by His establishment of them and His will for them to stand in their specified spaces without a perceptible custodian. The expression command is used to exaggerate the perfection of power and independence from a tool. Then when He calls you with a single call from the earth, at once you will emerge is in apposition to that you will emerge with a singular interpretation as if it were said: And among His signs is the establishment of the heavens and the earth by His command, then you will emerge from the graves when He calls you with a single call and He says, O dead ones, come forth. What is meant is to liken the speed of the occurrence of that to the connection of His will without pause or need to undertake an action to the speed of the connection of the answer to the caller who is obeyed to his call. Then, either because of the lenient nature of its time or because of the greatness of what is in it and of the earth connected to his call, like your saying: I called him from the bottom of the valley, so he came up to me. You will not emerge, because what comes after if does not affect what comes before it. The second if is for surprise and therefore it takes the place of fa in the answer to the first.
30:26: 26 - “And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him.” They submit to His actions in them and do not refrain from them.
30:27: 27 - And it is He who begins creation and then repeats it after their destruction. And that is easier for Him and the repetition is easier for Him than the original in addition to your power and the analogy to your origins, otherwise they are the same for Him. That is why the ha is said to be for creation, and it is said easier in the sense of easy and the masculine he is for it or because the repetition means that He repeats. And to Him is the example is the description of the wondrous affair such as the general power and the complete wisdom. And whoever interprets it as saying there is no god but God meant by it the description of Oneness. The Most High is the one who has nothing equal to Him or similar to Him. In the heavens and the earth describes Him with what is in them, in meaning and expression. And He is the Exalted is the Able who is not unable to create a possible thing and repeat it. The Wise is the one who conducts actions according to His wisdom.
30:28: 28 - He has given you an example from yourselves, taken from their circumstances, which are the closest matters to you. Do you have from those whom your right hands possess? from your slaves? Partners in what We have provided for you? from wealth and other things. Then you are equal therein. So you and they are in it according to the law, acting in it as you act, even though they are human beings like you and it is on loan to you. The first from is for beginning, the second is for partiality, and the third is added to emphasize the question that runs in the course of negation. You fear them that they will monopolize control of it. As you fear yourselves as free people fear one another. Likewise is like that detail. We detail the verses We explain them, for detail is among the things that reveal and clarify meanings. For a people who understand who use their minds to ponder the examples.
30:29: 29 - Rather, those who do wrong follow their own desires without knowledge, ignorantly, nothing will suffice them. If a scholar follows his own desires, his knowledge may deter him. Then who can guide one whom God has led astray? "And they will have no helpers," to save them from misguidance and protect them from its harms.
30:30: 30 - So set your face toward the religion, inclining toward truth. So set it straight for it, not turning away or turning away from it, and it is a metaphor for turning toward it, being steadfast toward it, and paying attention to it. The nature of God is his creation, accusative of enticement or the source of what is indicated by what comes after it. In which He has created mankind He created them upon it, which is their acceptance of the truth and their ability to have Adam and his offspring. There is no changing the creation of God No one has the power to change it or what should be changed. That is a reference to the religion that one is commanded to set one's face toward, or the nature if it is interpreted as the religion. The upright religion is the straight one in which there is no crookedness. But most people do not know straightness due to their lack of contemplation.
30:31: 31 - Returning to Him returning to Him from anaba if he returns time after time, and it was said that we are cut off to Him from naab which is a state of the pronoun in the accusative that is understood for the nature of God or in umm because the verse is addressed to the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the nation for His saying: And fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with God except that it began by addressing the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, to glorify him.
30:32: 32 - Of those who divided their religion instead of the polytheists, and their division is their disagreement over what they worship due to their differing desires. Hamzah and Al-Kisa'i read (faraqu) meaning they abandoned the religion they were commanded to follow. And they were sects groups, each following its imam who led its religion astray. Every party rejoicing in what it has happy, thinking that it is the truth. It is permissible to make rejoicing an attribute of each, so that the predicate is of those who divided.
30:33: 33 - And when distress touches people, they call upon their Lord, turning to Him in repentance. Turning back from calling upon anyone other than Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Himself, as deliverance from that distress, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord. A party of them suddenly associate others with their Lord who has healed them.
30:34: 34 - "That they may disbelieve in what We have given them." The lam in it is for the consequence, and it was said that it is for the command with the meaning of a threat, as He said: "Then enjoy yourselves." However, it was twisted in it for emphasis, and it was read as (li-tamattu). "You will soon know the consequence of your enjoyment, and it was read with the ya below it on the basis that tamattu" is past tense.
30:35: 35 - Or have We sent down to them authority? An argument. It was also said that it was an authority, meaning a king with proof. So he speaks. He spoke by implication, like his saying, Our Book speaks to you with the truth. Or he spoke. What they used to associate with Him? By their association and its validity, or by the matter because of which they associate with Him in His divinity.
30:36: 36 - "And when We let people taste mercy" a blessing of health and abundance. "They rejoice therein" they become arrogant because of it. "But if evil befalls them" severity. "For what their hands have put forth" the evil of their sins. "At once they despair" they are suddenly despairing of His mercy. Al-Kisa'i and Abu Amr read it with a kasra on the noon.
30:37: 37 - "Have they not seen that God expands provision for whom He wills and restricts it? So why are they grateful and do not expect reward in prosperity and adversity like the believers? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe." They use it as evidence of the perfection of power and wisdom.
30:38: 38 - Give the relative his right such as maintaining kinship ties, and the Hanafis used it as evidence for the obligation of spending on mahrams even though he is not aware of it. The poor and the wayfarer what is allocated for them from zakat, and the address is to the Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, or to the one to whom God has provided for him, and that is why it is arranged after what came before it with the letter fa. That is best for those who desire the countenance of God Himself or His direction, meaning they intend their good deed purely for Him, or the purpose of drawing closer to Him and no other purpose. And those are the successful as they attained, through what God has provided for them, the eternal bliss.
30:39: 39 - And whatever you give in interest is a forbidden increase in a transaction or a gift with the expectation of further reward. Ibn Kathir read it in the shortened form, meaning what you give in interest. That it may increase in the wealth of the people is for their wealth to increase and flourish. But it will not increase with God so it will not grow in His sight and will not be blessed in it. Nafi’ and Ya’qub read that it may increase meaning that you may increase or become people of interest. And whatever you give in zakat, desiring thereby the Face of God, sincerely, then those are the multiplied ones. Those who have the reward multiplied. The equivalent of multiplied is the one who is strengthened and wealthy for those with strength and wealth, or those whose reward and wealth have been multiplied by the blessing of zakat. It was read with the opening of the ‘ayn and changing it from the Sunnah of the parallel, in expression and structure for exaggeration, and the shift in it is for glorification as if he addressed it to the angels and the elite of creation, defining their state, or for generalization as if he said: So whoever does that, then those are the multiplied ones. The referent of it is omitted if you make ma a relative pronoun meaning those who are multiplied by it, or give it to him then those are the multiplied ones.
30:40: 40 - "God is He who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, then will bring you to life. Is there any of your partners who does any of that?" He established for Him the requirements of divinity and denied them completely from what they took as partners with Him from idols and other things, emphasizing with denial what was indicated by proof and sight and agreed upon, then He concluded from that His sanctity from having partners, so He said: Glory be to Him, and exalted above what they associate with Him. It is possible that the relative word is an attribute and the predicate is Is there any of your partners? and the link is of that because it means of His actions, and the first and second of indicate that the rule is widespread in the type of partners and actions, and the third is added to generalize the negated, and each of them is independent to emphasize the inability of the partners, and Hamza and Al-Kisa'i read with the letter ta'.
30:41: 41 - Corruption has appeared on land and sea such as drought, death, frequent burning, drowning, failure of divers, the eradication of blessings, and frequent harm, or misguidance and injustice. It was said that what is meant by the sea are the coastal villages, and it was read as and the seas. Because of what the hands of people have earned by the evil of their sins or by their earning it. It was said that corruption appeared on land by the killing of Cain by his brother, and on the sea by Julanda, the king of Oman, seizing every ship by force. That He may make them taste some of what they have done some of its recompense, for its completion will be in the Hereafter, and the lam is for the reason or the consequence. Ibn Kathir and Ya'qub said, That We may taste them with the noon, perhaps they will return from what they were doing.
30:42: 42 - Say, ‘Travel through the land and observe what was the end of those before.’ So that you may witness the truth of that and ascertain its truth. Most of them were polytheists. This is a resumption to indicate that their bad end was due to the prevalence and prevalence of polytheism among them, or that polytheism was present in most of them and lesser sins were present in a few of them.
30:43: 43 - So direct your face toward the right religion, the most upright. Before there comes a Day from which there is no averting, which no one can avert. His statement, from God, is connected to comes, and it is permissible for it to be connected to repelled, because it is a verbal noun meaning God does not avert it, due to His eternal will being connected to its coming. On that Day they will be divided, "will be divided," meaning they will be scattered. "A group will be in Paradise and a group in the Blaze," as He said.
30:44: 44 - Whoever disbelieves, upon him is his disbelief meaning its consequences, which is the eternal fire. And whoever does righteousness, they prepare for themselves they prepare a home in Paradise. The adverbial phrase is brought forward in both instances to indicate exclusivity.
30:45: 45 - That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds from His bounty is the reason for paving the way or spreading forth, and restricting it to the reward of the believers is to indicate that it is the intended one in particular and to be satisfied with the meaning of His statement: He does not love the disbelievers, for it establishes hatred for them and love for the believers, and confirms the specificity of the righteousness understood from leaving their pronoun to explicitly mentioning them is a reason for it, and from His bounty indicates that the reward is pure favor, and interpreting it as giving or increasing the reward is a deviation from the apparent meaning.
30:46: 46 - And among His signs is that He sends the winds the north, east, and south winds, for they are the winds of mercy, while the north wind is the wind of torment. From this is the saying of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him): O God, make them winds and do not make them a cold wind. Ibn Kathir, Hamzah, and Al-Kisa'i read the wind to mean the genus. Good tidings of rain. And that He may let you taste of His mercy meaning the benefits that come with it. It was said that it is the fertility that comes with the rain that is caused by it, or the spirit that is with its blowing. The conjunction is based on an omitted cause indicated by good tidings or on it based on the meaning, or on sends by implying a reasoned verb that it indicates. And that the ships may sail by His command and that you may seek of His bounty meaning trade at sea. And that you may be grateful and that you may be grateful for the blessing of God the Most High therein.
30:47: 47 - And We had certainly sent before you messengers to their people, and they came to them with clear proofs, and We took retribution from those who committed crimes by destroying them. And it was incumbent upon Us to aid the believers indicating that retribution is for them and demonstrating their honor, as He made them deserving of God's aid. And from him, peace and blessings be upon him, There is no Muslim man who defends the honor of his brother except that it is incumbent upon God to defend him from the fire of Hell, then he recited that. And it may be stopped at incumbent as being related to retribution.
30:48: 48 - God is He who sends the winds, and they stir up the clouds, then He spreads them out continuously at times. In the sky in its direction. How He wills moving or standing, closed or not closed from one side to another, etc. And He makes it in fragments in pieces at other times. Ibn Amir read it with a sukoon, as if it were a lightened form, or the plural of fragment, or a verbal noun describing it. So you see the drizzle is the rain. It comes out from within it in both cases. So when He causes it to fall upon whomever He wills of His servants meaning their countries and lands. At once they rejoice at the coming of fertility.
30:49: 49 - And if they were before the rain came down upon them. “Before it” is a repetition to emphasize and indicate the length of time they had not had rain and the severity of their despair. It was said that the pronoun refers to the rain, the clouds, or the sending down. Desperate is for hopeless.
30:50: 50 - So look at the traces of God's mercy The traces of rain on plants, trees, and various types of fruits. That is why Ibn Amir, Hamzah, Al-Kisa'i, and Hafs collected it together. How He revives the earth after its death It was read with a ta' as it is attributed to the pronoun of mercy. That indicates that He who is able to revive the earth after its death. The One Who revives the dead is able to revive them, for He is bringing into being the like of what was in the materials of their bodies of animal powers, just as bringing the earth into being is the like of what was in it of plant powers. It is possible that among the present creatures there are materials that were disintegrated and scattered of their kind in some past years. And He is over all things competent because the proportion of His power to all possibilities is equal.
30:51: 51 - And if We send a wind and they see it yellow they see the trace or the crops, then this is indicated by what was mentioned above. It was also said that it refers to the clouds because if it is yellow then it does not rain, and the lam is used to indicate an oath and it was added to the conditional particle. His statement, they would have continued to disbelieve after that is an answer to the substitute for the consequence, and therefore it was interpreted as meaning the future. This verse is a reproach to the disbelievers for their lack of steadfastness, lack of contemplation, and quickness to falter due to their lack of thinking and bad opinion. Sound judgment dictates that they put their trust in God and turn to Him in seeking forgiveness when He deems rain to be from them, and that they not despair of His mercy, and that they hasten to be grateful and to continue to obey when He bestows His mercy upon them, and that they not be excessive in rejoicing, and that they be patient in His affliction when He strikes their crops with yellowness, and that they not be ungrateful for His blessings.
30:52: 52 - For you cannot make the dead hear and they are like them because they have blocked their feelings from the truth. And the deaf cannot hear the call when they turn their backs He restricted the ruling to it to make it more impossible, for the deaf person who is approaching, even if he does not hear the speech, will understand something of it by means of the movements. Ibn Kathir read it with the yaa open and raising (the deaf).
30:53: 53 - And you cannot guide the blind from their misguidance. He called them blind because they lost the true purpose of sight or because their hearts were blind. Hamza alone read it as You guide the blind. "You only make hear those who believe in Our verses." Their faith calls them to receive the wording and ponder the meaning. It is possible that what is meant by the believer is the one who is close to faith. "They are Muslims" to what you command them to do.
30:54: 54 - God is He who created you from weakness meaning He began you weak and made weakness the basis of your affair, as He said, He created man weak or He created you from a weak origin, which is the sperm. Then after weakness He made strength, that is when you reach puberty or the soul has attached to your bodies. Then after strength He made weakness and gray hair, when you have become old. Asim and Hamzah opened the ḍād in all of them, and the ḍammah is stronger, based on the statement of Ibn Umar, may God be pleased with them both: I recited it to the Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, from weakness, so he recited to me from weakness. They are two languages, like poverty and poverty, and the indefinite article is the repetition because the later is not the same as the earlier. He creates what He wills of weakness, strength, youth, and gray hair. And He is the Knowing, the All-Powerful, for repetition in different situations when it is possible to do otherwise is evidence of knowledge and power.
30:55: 55 - And the Day the Hour will come to pass. The Resurrection was named thus because it will come in the last hour of the worldly hours, or because it will happen suddenly and will become known by force, like the planet Venus. The criminals will divide how long they remained in this world or in the graves or between the passing of this world and the resurrection and the cessation of their punishment. In the hadith, Between the passing of this world and the resurrection is forty, which may mean hours, days, or years. Other than an hour They considered the length of their remaining to be in addition to the length of their punishment in the Hereafter, or they forgot. Likewise is like that, turning away from truth and verification. They were lying They were turning away in this world.
30:56: 56 - And those who were given knowledge and faith said, from among the angels and mankind. You have remained in the Book of God, in His knowledge or His judgment, or what He has written for you, i.e., what He has made obligatory, or the Tablet or the Qur’an, which is His statement: And behind them is a barrier, “until the Day of Resurrection,” thereby rejecting what they had said and sworn to. This is the Day of Resurrection, which you denied. But you did not know, that it was true due to your negligence in considering. The fa is the answer to an omitted condition, the meaning of which is: If you were to deny the Resurrection, then this is its day, meaning the invalidity of your denial has become clear.
30:57: 57 - On that Day, the excuse of those who did wrong will not benefit them. The Kufians read it with a ya' because excuse means apology, or because its feminine form is not real and a distinction has been made between them. Nor will they be asked to repent they will not be called to what necessitates their repentance, i.e., the removal of their repentance through repentance and obedience, as they were called to in this world, when they said, So-and-so asked me to repent, so I repented to him, meaning he satisfied me, so I satisfied him.
30:58: 58 - And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example. And We have described them therein with various descriptions that are as strange as examples, such as the description of those resurrected on the Day of Resurrection in what they will say and what will be said to them and what will not be of benefit from excuses and seeking forgiveness, or We have made clear to them from every example that alerts them to monotheism, resurrection, and the truthfulness of the Messenger. And if you bring them a sign from the verses of the Qur'an, those who disbelieve will surely say from the excess of their stubbornness and the hardness of their hearts, You meaning the Messenger and the believers, are nothing but falsifiers falsifiers.
30:59: 59 - Likewise is the nature. God seals the hearts of those who do not know. They do not invalidate knowledge and insist on the superstitions they believe, because compound ignorance prevents the perception of the truth and necessitates the denial of the truthful.
30:60: 60 - So be patient" over their harm. "Indeed, the promise of God to support you and make your religion prevail over all religions is true" and must be fulfilled. "And let not He make you impatient" nor cause you to be light-hearted and anxious. "Those who have no certainty" of their denial and harm, for they are doubters and astray, and that is not something new from them. And it was narrated from Ya'qub with a lightened "nun", and it was read (nor does He deserve you) meaning, let Him not deviate you, so that they will be more deserving of you with the believers. It was narrated from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, "Whoever recites Surat Ar-Rum will have ten good deeds for the number of every angel who glorifies God between the heaven and the earth, and he will make up for what he wasted during his day and night."
31:2: 2 - These are the verses of the Wise Book. This was previously explained in (Yunus).
31:3: 3 - Guidance and mercy for the doers of good are two states of the verses, and the factor in them is the meaning of indication, and Hamza raised them as report after the report or report for something deleted.
31:4: 4 - Those who establish prayer and give zakat and are certain of the Hereafter. This is a statement of their goodness or a specification of these three from its branches for the virtue of being considered and the repetition of the pronoun for emphasis and because it was prevented from its predicate.
31:5: 5 - Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful ones. For they have combined the true belief and righteous deeds.
31:6: 6 - And among the people is he who buys idle talk that distracts from what he means, such as baseless hadiths, myths that are not considered, jokes, and idle talk. The addition has the meaning of from and is explanatory if he means a rejected hadith and partial if he means a more general one. It was said that it was revealed about Al-Nadr ibn Al-Harith who bought the books of the non-Arabs and used to tell them to the Quraysh, saying: If Muhammad tells you the stories of Aad and Thamud, then I will tell you the stories of Rustam, Isfandiyar, and the Chosroes. It was also said that he used to buy female singers and urge them to associate with those who wanted to convert to Islam and prevent them from it. To mislead [people] from the path of God his religion or the recitation of His Book. Ibn Kathir and Abu Amr read it with a fat-ha on the yaa' meaning to persist in his misguidance and increase it. Without knowledge is the state of what he buys or trade, as he replaced idle talk with the recitation of the Quran. And he takes it in ridicule and takes the path in mockery. Hamza, Al-Kisa'i, Ya'qub, and Hafs put it in the accusative case in apposition to to mislead. "For those is a humiliating punishment" for humiliating the truth by making falsehood monopolize it.
31:7: 7 - And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly. Arrogant, not paying attention to them. As if he had not heard them. His condition is similar to that of someone who has not heard them. As if there is a heaviness in his ears. His condition is similar to that of someone who has a heaviness in his ears and is unable to hear. The first is a state of what is hidden in turn away or in arrogantly. The second is a substitute for it or a state of what is hidden in did not hear it. It is possible that they are both resumptions. Nafi' read in his ears. "Then give him tidings of a painful punishment." He informed him that the punishment would inevitably surround him, and he mentioned the tidings as a mockery.
31:8: 8 - Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds will have gardens of pleasure. That is, they will have the pleasures of the gardens. This is an inversion for emphasis.
31:9: 9 - They will abide therein eternally is a state of the pronoun in for them or of gardens of delight and the factor is what the lam is attached to. The promise of God is true is two confirmed sources, the first for Himself and the second for someone else because His saying for them are gardens is a promise but not every promise is true. And He is the Exalted in Might who is not overcome by anything that prevents Him from fulfilling His promise and threat. The Wise who does nothing except what His wisdom calls for.
31:10: 10 - "He created the heavens without pillars that you can see" has been mentioned previously in (Al-Ra`d). "And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains" lofty mountains. "lest it should move with you" He hates that it should move with you, because the similarity of its parts necessitates the change of its spaces and positions, as it is impossible for each of them to be dedicated to itself or to something of its necessities in a specific space and position. "And He dispersed therein every kind of creature, and We sent down water from the sky and caused to grow therein every noble pair" of every kind of much benefit. It is as if He used this as evidence of His might, which is the perfection of power, and His wisdom, which is the perfection of knowledge, and He paved the way for the foundation of monotheism with it and established it with His saying:
31:11: 11 - "This is the creation of God, so show me what those other than Him have created. This is what He mentioned as His creation, so what did your gods create that they deserved to share with Him? What is in the accusative case with created" or what is raised as a subject and its predicate is related to it. "Show me" is suspended from it. "Rather, the wrongdoers are in manifest error." This is a departure from rebuking them to recording them with the error that is not hidden from the observer, and the apparent is placed in the place of the implicit to indicate that they are wrongdoers by associating partners with God.
31:12: 12 - And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom meaning Luqman ibn Ba'oura, one of the sons of Azar, the nephew or maternal aunt of Job. He lived until he saw David (peace be upon him) and took knowledge from him. He used to issue fatwas before his mission. The majority say that he was a wise man but not a prophet. Wisdom, in the terminology of scholars, is the perfection of the human soul by acquiring theoretical knowledge and gaining the complete ability to perform virtuous deeds according to one's capacity. Part of his wisdom is that he accompanied David for months while sewing his coat of mail but he did not ask him about it. When he finished, he put it on and said, You are an excellent garment of war. He said, Silence is wisdom, but few do it. One day, David (peace be upon him) asked him, How are you? He said, I am now in someone else's hands. David thought about it and was struck dumb. And that he ordered him to slaughter a sheep and bring the two best morsels from it, so he brought the tongue and the heart. Then after a few days he ordered him to bring the two worst morsels, so he brought them as well. He asked him about that, and he said: They are the best thing if they are good and the worst thing if they are bad. To be grateful to God to be grateful or any gratitude, because giving wisdom is in the meaning of speech. And whoever is grateful is grateful for his own soul because his benefit returns to it and it is the continuity of the blessing and the deserving of more of it. And whoever is ungrateful, then indeed, God is Free of need is in no need of gratitude. Praiseworthy is worthy of praise even if He is not praised, or Praised, all of His creatures speak His praise with the tongue of the state.
31:13: 13 - And when Luqman said to his son, Anaam or Ashkam or Mathan, while he was admonishing him, O my son. The diminutive of ishfaq. Ibn Kathir read here and in O my son, establish prayer with a sukoon on the ya', and Hafs in both of them and in O my son, if you are" with a fatha on the ya', and likewise Al-Bazzi in the last one, and the rest read in the three with a kasra on the ya'. "Do not associate partners with God." It was said that he was a disbeliever, but he continued to do so until he converted to Islam. Whoever stops at "Do not associate partners" makes an oath with God. "Indeed, polytheism is a great injustice," because it equates between someone who has no blessing except from Him and someone who has no blessing from Him.
31:14: 14 - And We have enjoined upon man, concerning his parents, his mother bore him with weakness with weakness or she became weak with weakness upon weakness meaning she became weaker with weakness, for she continues to double her weakness. The sentence is in the position of a circumstantial adverbial. It was read with a fat-ha, it is said wahan yasin wa hanna and wahan yahuwayn wa hanna. And his weaning is in two years and his weaning is at the end of two years, and she was breastfeeding him during that period. It was read (and his weaning is in two years) and in it is evidence that the maximum period of breastfeeding is two years. That you be grateful to Me and to your parents is an explanation of We have enjoined or a reason for it or a substitute for his parents as a substitute for inclusion. The mention of the pregnancy and weaning in between is an objection confirming the recommendation in her right in particular. Hence, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said to the one who said, Who is most dutiful to you? "Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then he said after that, your father, To Me is the final destination," so I will hold you accountable for your gratitude and your ingratitude.
31:15: 15 - And if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge of its deserving association by imitating them, and it was said that what he meant by denying knowledge of it was its denial. Do not obey them in that. And accompany them in this world with appropriate kindness with appropriate companionship, as the Shari'ah approves and generosity requires. And follow in religion the way of him who turns back to Me with monotheism and sincerity in obedience. Then to Me is your return your return and theirs. Then I will inform you of what you used to do by rewarding you for your faith and rewarding them for their disbelief. The two verses are interposed within the folds of Luqman's advice to emphasize what is in them of forbidding polytheism, as if he said: We have been commanded with the same as he was commanded. The parents are mentioned to emphasize that, as they prevented that they are after the Creator in deserving of reverence and obedience, and it is not permissible for them to deserve it in associating partners with God, so what do you think of others? They descended upon Sa`d ibn Abi Waqqas and his mother. She remained in the company of his converts for three days without eating anything during that time. Therefore, it was said that whoever Abu Bakr, may God be pleased with him, turned to him, then he converted to Islam through his call.
31:16: 16 - O my son, if it were the weight of a mustard seed meaning that the characteristic of goodness or badness, if it were, for example, in childhood, like a mustard seed. Nafi' raised mithqal on the basis that the ha' is the pronoun of the story and it was complete and its feminization is to add the mithqal to the seed like the poet's saying: As the chest of the canal was filled with blood Or because what is meant by it is good or bad. Then it will be in a rock or in the heavens or in the earth in the most hidden and secure place, such as the hollow of a rock, or its top, such as the convexity of the heavens, or its bottom, such as the concaveness of the earth. It is read with a kasra on the kaf from the bird’s nest, if it settles in its nest. God will bring it will bring it and hold it accountable for it. Indeed, God is Subtle His knowledge reaches every hidden thing. Aware Knowing of its essence.
31:17: 17 - O my son, establish prayer to complete yourself. And enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong to complete others. And be patient over what befalls you of hardships, especially in that. Indeed, that is a reference to patience or to everything that was commanded. Of the matters that God has resolved of matters, meaning He has cut it off with an affirmative cut, a source used for the passive participle, and it is permissible for it to have the meaning of the subject from His saying So when he has resolved the matter meaning he has become serious.
31:18: 18 - And do not turn your cheek away from people Do not turn it away from them and do not turn your face towards them as the arrogant do from sa'r, which is a disease of the camel that twists its neck. Nafi', Abu Amr, Hamza and Al-Kisa'i read and do not turn your cheek away, and it was also read and do not turn your face away and they are all the same like 'alahu, a'lahu and 'alahu. And do not walk on the earth exultantly meaning exultantly, a source that falls in the position of a state, meaning you act exultantly or for the sake of exultation, which is arrogance. Indeed, God does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful is the reason for the prohibition and the delay of fakhir which is the opposite of someone who turns up his cheek and the one who is exultant is the one who walks exultantly to agree with the beginnings of the verses.
31:19: 19 - And be moderate in your walk. He said in it a middle way between crawling and hurrying. And it was narrated from him, peace and blessings be upon him, Walk quickly takes away the glory of the believer. And the saying of Aisha about Omar, may God be pleased with them both, that when he walked he would hurry, meaning more than the crawling of someone dying. And it was read with the hamza cut off from the word aqsad ar-ramy when he aimed his arrow towards the target. And lower your voice and make it less and shorter. The most disagreeable of sounds is the most monstrous. The voice of donkeys and the donkey is an example of blame especially for its braying and that is why it is called long-eared. In representing the loud voice with his voice and then making it appear as a metaphor, there is a great exaggeration and the sound is unified because what is meant is to prefer the genus in the indefinite rather than the singular, or because it is a source in the original.
31:20: 20 - Have you not seen that God has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens by making it a means for your benefit. And whatever is on the earth by enabling you to benefit from it through or without a medium. And has bestowed upon you His favors, apparent and hidden, tangible and intelligible, what you know and what you do not know. The explanation of the favor and its details have been mentioned in Al-Fatihah. And Asbagh was read with substitution, and it is a preposition for every seen that is combined with ghayn, “kha,” or qaf, like salakh and saqr. Nafi’, Abu ‘Amr, and Hafs read Na’mah with the plural and addition. And among the people is he who disputes about God in His Oneness and attributes. Without knowledge is derived from evidence. Nor guidance refers to a Messenger. Nor an enlightening Book that God revealed, but rather by imitation, as He said:
31:21: 21 - And when it is said to them, ‘Follow what God has revealed,’ they say, ‘Rather, we will follow what we found our fathers doing.’ This is an explicit prohibition of imitation in the fundamentals. Or if Satan were to invite them it is possible that the pronoun refers to them and their fathers. “to the punishment of the Blaze” to what it leads to of imitation or polytheism and an omitted answer such as they would not have followed him. The question is for denial and astonishment.
31:22: 22 - And whoever submits his face to God by entrusting his affair to Him and turning his evils to Him like submitting the merchandise to the customer, and this is supported by the reading with emphasis, and when it is transitive with lam, it includes the meaning of sincerity. And he is a doer of good in his work. He has grasped the most trustworthy handhold He has grasped the most trustworthy handhold, and it is a metaphor for the one who trusts and is occupied with obedience, like someone who wants to climb a high mountain, so he grasps the most trustworthy rope hanging from it. And to God is the outcome of all matters since everything will return to Him.
31:23: 23 - And whoever disbelieves - let not his disbelief grieve you for it will not harm you in this world or the Hereafter. It was also read let not his disbelief grieve you from to grieve but it is not widespread. To Us is their return in both abodes. Then We will inform them of what they did of destruction and torment. Indeed, God is Knowing of that within the breasts so He punished him in addition to what is apparent.
31:24: 24 - We grant them enjoyment for a little while enjoyment or for a short time, for what passes away is little in comparison to what lasts. Then We will force them to a severe punishment that will weigh down on them like the weight of heavy bodies or will add pressure to the burning.
31:25: 25 - And if you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'God.' This is due to the clarity of the evidence preventing the attribution of creation to anyone other than Him, such that they were compelled to broadcast it. Say, 'Praise be to God.' This obligates them and compels them to acknowledge what would invalidate their belief. But most of them do not know, that this is obligatory for them.
31:26: 26 - To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. None deserves to be worshipped in them except Him. Indeed, God is the Free of need of the praise of those who praise Him. The Praiseworthy is the One who deserves praise even if He is not praised.
31:27: 27 - "And if all the trees on earth were pens." Even if it were proven, then the trees would be pens. The singular form of "tree" is because what is meant is the detailing of individuals. "And the sea, replenished thereafter by seven more seas." The sea encompassing its vastness is ink replenished by seven seas, so there is no need to mention the ink with its extension because it is from the extension of the inkwell and its extension. The nominative case is in apposition to the position of "an and its dependents, and its extension" is a state or for the beginning as a new sentence or the waw is for the state. The two Basrans put it in the accusative case in apposition to the name of "an or the omission of a verb that is explained by its extension." It was read (its extension) with a ya and a ta. "The words of God have not been exhausted" by writing them with those pens with that ink. The plural of fewness was preferred to indicate that that is not sufficient with little, so how about with much. "Indeed, God is Exalted in Might" nothing is beyond His power. Wise nothing is outside His knowledge and His protection. The verse is an answer to the Jews who asked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, or ordered the Quraysh delegation to ask him about the Almighty’s saying: And of knowledge you have been given only a little, and He revealed the Torah, in which is knowledge of everything.
31:28: 28 - He did not create you and resurrect you except as a single soul except as its creation and resurrection, since no matter distracts Him from another matter, because it is sufficient for the existence of the whole to be connected to His necessary will along with His intrinsic power, as He said, Our word to a thing when We intend it is only that We say to it, ‘Be,’ and it is. “Indeed, God is Hearing” He hears everything that is heard. Seeing He sees everything that is seen. He is not distracted by the perception of some of them from others, so that is the truth.
31:29: 29 - "Have you not seen that God merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night? And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course]" Each of the two luminaries runs in its orbit. "For a specified term" For a known limit, the sun until the end of the year and the moon until the end of the month. And it was said until the Day of Resurrection. The difference between it and His statement "for a specified term is that the term" here is the limit of the running, and there its purpose is literal or metaphorical, and both meanings are achieved in the ends. "And that God is Acquainted with what you do" Knowing of its essence.
31:30: 30 - "That" refers to what was mentioned of the vastness of knowledge, the comprehensiveness of power, the wonders of creation, and the exclusive right of the Creator to them. "That God is the Truth" because He is the constant in His Essence, the Necessary in all His aspects, or the constant in His divinity. "And that what they call upon besides Him is falsehood" that is non-existent in itself because it does not exist and is not described except by His making it, or falsehood in its divinity. The two Basrans and the Kufians, other than Abu Bakr, read it with the letter "yaa". "And that God is the Most High, the Great" transcending everything and dominating it.
31:31: 31 - Have you not seen that the ships sail through the sea by the grace of God? By His benevolence in providing its causes, and this is another testimony to the dazzling power, perfect wisdom, and comprehensiveness of His blessings. The letter ba is for connection or state, and the ship is read with emphasis, and by the blessings of God with a sukoon on the 'ayn, and in similar cases, the kasra, fatha, and sukoon are permissible. That He may show you of His signs His evidence. Indeed in that are signs for every patient in the face of hardships, so he tires himself out by contemplating the horizons and himself. Appreciative He recognizes the blessings and recognizes their Giver, or for the believers, for faith is two halves, half patience and half gratitude.
31:32: 32 - And when it covers them rises above them and covers them. A wave like the shadows as one covers a mountain or cloud or other than them. It is read as shadows, the plural of shadow, like qala and qalaal. They call upon God, devoting to Him religion because of the removal of what conflicts with the innate nature of desires and imitation due to the intense fear that has befallen them. Then when He has delivered them to the land, some of them are moderate steadfast on the straight path, which is monotheism, or moderate in disbelief because of their some aversion. And none denies Our signs except every traitor traitor, for he breaks the natural covenant, or because what is in the sea, and the traitor is the most severe treachery. ungrateful for blessings.
31:33: 33 - O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son will not make up for him. It was also read will not suffice from ajzaa if it enriches, and the referent to the described is omitted, meaning it will not suffice. Nor a newborn is in apposition to father or a subject whose predicate is He availed his father at all and the change in the rhyme is to indicate that the newborn is more deserving of not being able to suffice, and to cut off the hope of the believers who expect that they will benefit their disbelieving father in the Hereafter. Indeed, the promise of God of reward and punishment is truth and cannot be broken. So let not the worldly life deceive you, and let not the Deceiver deceive you about God Satan by making you hope for repentance and forgiveness, thus emboldening you to commit sins.
31:34: 34 - Indeed, God has knowledge of the Hour means the time of its occurrence. It was narrated that Al-Harith ibn Amr came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: "When will the Hour come? I have cast my grains on the earth and the sky is still raining? Will my wife be pregnant, will she be pregnant with a boy or a girl? What do I hope for tomorrow, and where will I die?" So this verse was revealed. It was also narrated from him, may God bless him and grant him peace, The keys of the unseen are five, and he recited this verse. And He sends down the rain is to clarify what is destined for it and the place designated for it in His knowledge. Nafi', Ibn Amir, and Asim read it with emphasis. And He knows what is in the wombs is male or female, orphans or deficient. And no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow of good or evil, and it may resolve to do something but do the opposite. And no soul knows in what land it will die just as it does not know at what time it will die. It was narrated that the Angel of Death passed by Solomon and kept looking at one of his companions who kept composing poetry to him. The man asked, Who is this? He said, The Angel of Death. He said, It is as if he wants me, so command the wind to carry me and throw me into India. So the angel said, My constant looking at him was out of amazement at him, since I was commanded to take his soul in India while he was with you. Knowledge is given to God Almighty and awareness to the servant because it contains the meaning of cunning, so one feels the difference between the two types of knowledge. It indicates that if he works a cunning and does his best in it, he will not know what is right for him in terms of his earnings and its consequences, so how about other things for which no evidence has been established? It was read (in any land) and Sibawayh likened its feminization to the feminization of all in all of them. “God is Knowing” means He knows all things. Aware means He knows their inner aspects as we know their outer aspects. On the authority of him, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, Whoever recites Surat Luqman, Luqman will be his companion on the Day of Resurrection, and he will be given ten times the number of good deeds he did and forbade evil.
32:1: 1- Alif, Lam, Meem if it is the name of the surah or the Qur’an, then it is the subject and predicate:
32:2: 2- The revelation of the Book on the basis that revelation means the one who revealed, and if it was made an enumeration of letters, then the revelation would be the predicate of a deleted subject or a subject whose predicate is: There is no doubt about it, so it would be. From the Lord of the Worlds is a state of the pronoun in the pronoun in in it because the source does not work after the predicate, and it is permissible for it to be a second predicate and there is no doubt about it is a state of the Book, or an objection and the pronoun in it is for the content of the sentence and this is supported by his saying:
32:3: 3- Or do they say, ‘He invented it’? This is a denial of it being from the Lord of the Worlds. His saying, Rather, it is the truth from your Lord is a confirmation of it. The structure of the speech on this basis is that he first pointed to its miraculous nature, then he arranged for it that its revelation is from the Lord of the Worlds, and he confirmed that by denying any doubt about it, then he turned away from that to what they say about it contrary to that, denying it and expressing amazement at it, for Or is disconnected, then he turned away from it to prove that it is the truth revealed from God, and he explained the purpose of its revelation, saying: That you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you if they were the people of the period. Perhaps they will be guided by your warning them.
32:4: 4- God is He who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, then He established Himself on the Throne. This was explained in Al-A’raf. You have no protector or intercessor besides Him. “You have no protector or intercessor” If you transgress the pleasure of God, you have no one to support you or intercede for you, or “You have no protector or intercessor other than Him. Rather, He is the One who takes care of your interests and supports you in the situations of your support, provided that the intercessor is used interchangeably with the helper, so if He forsakes you, you are left with no protector or helper. “Will you not remember?” with the admonitions of God the Most High.
32:5: 5- He directs the affair from the heaven to the earth He directs the affair of this world by heavenly means such as angels and others whose effects descend to the earth. Then it ascends to Him Then it ascends to Him and is established in His knowledge as existing. On a Day the measure of which is a thousand years of those which you count In a long period of time, meaning by that the length of time between the direction and the occurrence. It was said that He directs the affair by revealing it on the Tablet, and the Angel descends with it, then it ascends to Him in a time that is like a thousand years, because the distance of His descent and ascension is a journey of a thousand years, since the distance between the heaven and the earth is a journey of five hundred years. It was said that He decrees a decree of a thousand years, and the Angel descends with it, then it ascends after the thousand to another thousand. It was said that He directs the affair until the Hour comes, then the whole affair ascends to Him on the Day of Resurrection. It was said that He directs the commanded acts of obedience, descending from the heaven to the earth by revelation, then it does not ascend to Him purely as He pleases except in a long period due to the fewness of the sincere ones and sincere deeds. And it was read (He ascends) and (they count).
32:6: 6- He is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so He manages its affairs in accordance with wisdom. The Exalted in Might is the One who prevails over His affair. The Merciful over His servants in His management, and in it is an indication that He, glory be to Him, takes into account people’s interests out of favor and kindness.
32:7: 7- He who perfected everything which He created creation, providing it with what it is prepared for and what is appropriate for it in accordance with wisdom and interest. He created is a substitute for every a substitute of inclusion. And say, He knows how to create from their saying, The value of a person is what he improves, meaning, He improves his knowledge. “He created” is a second object. Nafi’ and the Kufians read it with a fat-ha on the lam as a description, so the thing according to the first is specified by a separate thing, and according to the second by a connected thing. And He began the creation of man meaning Adam. Made of clay.
32:8: 8- Then He made his offspring His offspring were named thus because they descend from him, i.e., they separate. From a lineage of despised water despised.
32:9: 9- Then He proportioned him He formed his limbs as they should be. And breathed into him of His spirit in addition to Himself, to honor him and to make him feel that he is a wondrous creation, and that he has a status that has some connection to the Divine Presence. For this reason it was said that whoever knows his negation has known his Lord. And He gave you hearing and sight and hearts especially so that you would hear, see, and understand. You give little thanks you give little thanks.
32:10: 10- And they said, 'Shall we, when we are lost in the earth?' That is, will we become dust mixed with the dust of the earth, unable to distinguish ourselves from it, or will we disappear into it? And he read ((... ((If) is the predicate and the agent in it indicates it. Are we really in a new creation? which means: We will be resurrected or our creation will be renewed. Nafi’ and Al-Kisa’i read it. Jacob (I) on the report, and the speaker is Abi bin Khalaf and his chain of transmission to all of them for their satisfaction with it. Rather, they are in the meeting with their Lord by resurrection or by receiving the Angel of Death and what comes after it. Disbelievers are deniers.
32:11: 11- Say, ‘He takes your souls’ He takes your souls, leaving nothing of them and not leaving any of you. The verbs ‘tafa’ala’ and ‘istif’ala’ meet frequently, such as ‘taqsaatuhu’ and ‘istaqsaatuhu’, ‘ajaltuhu’ and ‘ajaltuhu’. The Angel of Death who is assigned to you with taking your souls and counting your appointed times. Then to your Lord you will be returned for reckoning and recompense.
32:12: 12- And if you could but see when the criminals hang their heads before their Lord out of shame and disgrace. Our Lord, saying, Our Lord. “We have seen” what You promised us. And we have heard from You confirming Your messengers. So return us to the world. “We will do righteousness. Indeed, we are certain” since we have no doubt about what we have seen. The answer to if is omitted, meaning you would have seen a terrible thing. It is permissible for it to be for wishing and continuing with it and in when because what is established in God’s knowledge has the status of reality. An object cannot be assumed for you see because the meaning is if you could see at this time, or what is indicated by the connection of if can be assumed, and the address is to the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, or to everyone.
32:13: 13- And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance that which would guide it to faith and righteous deeds by granting it success. But the word from Me will come true My judgment has been established and My threat has preceded, which is I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together. This is a clear statement of their lack of faith due to the lack of will caused by the previous judgment that they are among the people of Hellfire. This is not refuted by making the taste of the torment caused by their forgetting the outcome and not thinking about it, as He says:
32:14: 14- So taste for having forgotten the meeting of this Day of yours. It is one of the means and causes that necessitate it. Indeed, We have forgotten you. We left you out of mercy, or in the punishment, leaving the forgotten. In its resumption and the construction of the verb af’al on the basis that its subject is an emphasis on taking revenge on them. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do. The command was repeated for emphasis and because it was connected to it of stating its effect and explaining it by their bad actions of denial and sins, just as it was explained by their leaving you and pondering the matter of the consequence and thinking about it, indicating that each of them necessitates that.
32:15: 15- “Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration out of fear of God. And glorify God with praise of their Lord, praising Him in thanks for having guided them to Islam and given them guidance. And they are not arrogant about faith and obedience, as happens when someone persists in arrogance.
32:16: 16- "Their sides forsake their beds" They rise and move away. "From their beds" The mattresses and sleeping places. "They call upon their Lord" Calling upon Him. "Out of fear" Of His wrath. "And hoping" For His mercy. "And from the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, in its interpretation, it is the servant's rising at night. And from him, may God bless him and grant him peace, when God gathers the first and the last in one place, a caller will come calling with a voice that all of creation will hear: The people of the gathering will know today who is most deserving of honor. Then he will return and call: Let those whose sides forsook their beds arise. So they will rise, and they will be few. Then he will return and call: Let those who praised God in prosperity and adversity arise. So they will rise, and they will be few. Then they will all depart to Paradise, and then the rest of the people will be held to account." It was said that some of the Companions used to pray the Maghrib prayer until the Isha prayer, so this was revealed about them. "And from what We have provided them they spend" In the ways of goodness.
32:17: 17- No soul knows what has been hidden for them no close angel nor sent prophet. Of comfort to eyes that will comfort their eyes. “And it was narrated from him, peace and blessings be upon him, that God the Most High said: I have prepared for My righteous servants that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart has conceived, let alone what I have informed them of. Read, for no soul knows what has been hidden for them.” Hamzah and Yaqub read hidden for them as a present tense verb I hid. The readings of nakhfi and akhfa indicate that the subject of each is God. Eyes was read because of the different types of it, and knowledge means knowledge, and ma is a relative pronoun or an interrogative from which the verb is suspended. As a reward for what they used to do meaning they were rewarded with a reward, or hidden is for the sake of the reward, as concealing it is due to its high status. It was said that these people concealed their deeds, so God concealed their reward.
32:18: 18- Is he who is a believer like he who is a sinner outside of faith they are not equal in honor and reward. This is an emphasis and clarification, and the plural is to carry the meaning.
32:19: 19- As for those who have believed and done righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Refuge. It is the true refuge, and this world is a home from which one will inevitably depart. It has also been said that refuge is a garden among the gardens. A lodging has been explained previously in Surah Al Imran. For what they used to do because of their deeds or because of their deeds.
32:20: 20- And as for those who disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire the place of Paradise, the refuge of the believers. 32:22: 22- And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the verses of his Lord and then turns away from them so he does not reflect on them, and then is to exclude turning away from them even if it is assumed that they are clear and guide to the causes of happiness after being reminded of them rationally as in the verse of enthusiasm. 32:23: 23- And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture as We gave you. So be not in doubt in suspicion. About meeting him about your meeting the Scripture, as He says: Indeed, you are receiving the Qur’an for We have given you of the Scripture the same as We gave him of it, so this is not an innovation that never happened, so that you would doubt it, or about Moses’ meeting the Scripture or about your meeting Moses. “And on his authority, peace and blessings be upon him, I saw on the night of my Night Journey, Moses, peace and blessings be upon him, a tall, curly-haired man, as if he were one of the men of Shanu’ah.” And We made it meaning the revelation sent down to Moses a guidance for the Children of Israel.
32:24: 24- And We made from among them leaders guiding people to the wisdom and rulings contained therein. By Our command to them or by Our granting them success. When they were patient. 32:25: 25- Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection He will judge and distinguish truth from falsehood, distinguishing the truthful from the false. regarding that over which they differed of matters of religion.
32:26: 26- "Did they not see" The waw is for connecting to something that is of the same type as the conjoined word, and the subject is the pronoun that indicates it. "How many generations before them We destroyed" meaning many of those We destroyed from the past generations, or the pronoun of God as evidenced by the reading with the nun. "Walking in their dwellings" meaning the people of Mecca passing through their shops and their homes, and it was read (They walk) with emphasis. “There are certainly signs in that. Will they not then hear?” Hearing, contemplation, and admonition.
32:27: 27- Have they not seen that We drive water to the barren land? The land whose vegetation has been cut off, that is, cut and removed, not the land that does not grow, as He says: Then We bring forth thereby crops. It was also said that it is the name of a place in Yemen. They eat from it of the crops. Their livestock such as figs and leaves. And themselves such as grain and fruit. Do they not see? So they can infer from it the perfection of His power and grace.
32:28: 28- And they say, ‘When will this conquest be?’ The victory or the decision by government from His saying, Our Lord, judge between us, “if you should be truthful” in the promise of it.
32:29: 29- Say, ‘On the Day of Conquest, the faith of those who disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved.’ This refers to the Day of Resurrection, for it is the day of victory for the believers over the disbelievers and the day of judgment between them. It was also said to be the day of Badr or the day of the conquest of Mecca. What is meant by those who disbelieved are those among them who were killed on that day, for their faith will not benefit them while they are being killed, nor will they be given respite. Its application is an answer to their question in terms of meaning, considering what is known of their purpose. Since they intended to hasten it by way of denial and mockery, they were answered with something that would prevent hastening.
32:30: 30- So turn away from them and do not care about their denial. It was said that it was abrogated by the verse of the sword. And await victory over them. They are awaiting victory over you.
